$comment: Mutation testing of the rest of core's model: links, ownership, the dependency graph, downstream changes, commands, actions, files, change notes, shortcuts, sessions. Run through run.sh, from packages/core. SVG has its own target (svg.json): its test takes 4 s, which would make every mutant here wait for it.

commandRunner.command: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings --test test/actions.test.ts test/change-notes.test.ts test/commands.test.ts test/downstream.test.ts test/files.test.ts test/graph.test.ts test/graph-scale.test.ts test/links.test.ts test/ownership.test.ts test/placeholders.test.ts test/selection.test.ts test/shortcuts.test.ts test/representation.test.ts test/project.test.ts test/model-survivors.test.ts
